newsitem.title: MEXICO: Ahmsa parent seeks partner to buy Sidor.
newsitem.headline: Ahmsa parent seeks partner to buy Sidor.

text.p: Grupo Acerero del Norte, the Mexican holding company that owns steelmaker Ahmsa, is looking into forming a consortium to bid for Venezuela's Siderurgica del Orinoco (Sidor), the company's chief executive said Tuesday.

"We are indeed considering (a partnership), and have several alternatives available. We have made approaches to Mexican, Venezuelan, German and Asian companies, but have yet to make a decision," Grupo Acerero CEO Xavier Autrey Maza said.
Autrey said a decision would be announced in January. He said there were currently 11 companies bidding for Sidor, the last state-owned steel company left in Latin America.
